summary: The x04b routes are mostly accurate; the main gaps are familiar meanings with no route yet (STRIPES Stars and Stripes via STAR/AMERICA, ICEBERG lettuce, GOTHAM as New York, Wendy's Frosty, Jaws of Life, Apollo Creed, Beatrix Potter) and a few clear one-word omissions (PICNIC TABLE, GOTHAM KNIGHT, UMBRELLA COCKTAIL, POOH KANGAROO, OGRE GREEN). The structural fixes are TENT (CAMPFIRE), UNICORN (RAINBOW) and WIND (UMBRELLA), each in a route that does not match its meaning; the weak entries are GARLIC KITCHEN and PHARAOH SNAKE, and WALRUS IVORY should drop to 1. Note that SHELF would be an obvious ELF target (Elf on the Shelf) but contains the hint, so it is correctly absent; no x04b route references a groups.json group, so there are no group findings.
